description: This file defines the `Permissions` interface in Java, which extends `Set<String>` and `Jsonifiable<JsonArray>`. It provides methods to create instances, check for containment of permissions, and specify supported JSON schema versions related to permissions management in a policy context.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new immutable `Permissions` instance containing the given permissions.

methods.name: none
methods.description: Creates a new `Permissions` instance with no permissions.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the JSON Schema versions supported by `Permissions`, specifically version V_2.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks whether this permission set contains the specified permission(s), returning true if all are contained.
